Part.name: TPD-K1 laser rangefinding gunner's sight
Part.description: Daylight gunner's sight with an integrated laser rangefinder. No separate rangefinder part is required. Assign it to a cannon and use Measure range while scoped to read the target distance. Configure the action in Settings / keybinds. Installing this sight enables laser ranging through the vehicle's sights. Does not automatically set gun elevation. Can be linked to an internal FCS. No thermal imaging.
